title: Picture Reading
source_note: NCERT structural alignment only. Zidd uses original teaching passages, checks, and feedback instead of copying the textbook body.

levels.title: Read a busy play picture
levels.focus: notice people, objects, and actions described in a scene
levels.teaching_goal: Use all the details in a picture description to answer who, what, and where questions.

guided_check.teaching_block: Picture readers scan from one side to the other. Worked example: if the description says “a boy beside the tree,” beside tells where. Count only the people named.
guided_check.passage: On the left, two children roll a hoop. On the right, one child waters a plant.

bridge.teaching_block: Separate the action from the object. A kite may be visible, but the question asks what the girl is doing.
bridge.passage: A red kite rests on a bench. Near it, a girl draws circles with chalk.

masterclass.teaching_block: Position words help you locate one detail among many. “Behind” is different from “under.”
masterclass.passage: A ball lies under the slide. A puppy waits behind the slide.

independent_check.teaching_block: Read the whole description and answer without choices. Do not add an action that is not stated.
independent_check.passage: At the school fair, Meena holds a paper fan while Jai carries two cups.

transfer_check.teaching_block: Transfer picture reading from a playground to a kitchen scene. The scanning skill stays the same.
transfer_check.passage: In a kitchen picture, a child washes a tomato. An adult cuts bread at the other counter.

levels.title: Actions inside the picture
levels.focus: identify action words in picture descriptions
levels.teaching_goal: Find words that show what a person or animal is doing in a pictured scene.

guided_check.teaching_block: An action word can be acted out. Worked example: in “The baby waves,” waves is the action. A thing like “flag” cannot be performed.

bridge.teaching_block: Some sentences contain a describing word close to the action. Ask “What does the person do?” to avoid choosing the colour.
bridge.prompt: Which word tells what Aman does?

masterclass.teaching_block: A picture can show more than one action. Match the named person to the correct verb.
masterclass.passage: Nia claps while her brother jumps.

independent_check.teaching_block: Find the action that belongs to the animal named in the question.
independent_check.passage: A squirrel nibbles a seed near the fence.

transfer_check.teaching_block: Use the action-word test in a street picture rather than a play picture.
transfer_check.passage: A cyclist waits while a guard signals.
transfer_check.prompt: Write the word that shows what the guard does.

levels.title: Where is it?
levels.focus: use position words to locate picture details
levels.teaching_goal: Use in, on, under, beside, behind, and between to tell where something appears.

guided_check.teaching_block: Position words connect two things. Worked example: “The cup is on the tray” means the cup touches the top of the tray.
guided_check.passage: A yellow bucket is under the tap.
guided_check.prompt: Which word tells the bucket’s position?

bridge.teaching_block: “Beside” means next to, not inside. Picture the two objects standing close together.
bridge.passage: The bat is beside the green bag.

masterclass.teaching_block: “Between” needs something on both sides. Check that the middle object has two neighbours.
masterclass.passage: A cone stands between the skipping rope and the ball.
masterclass.prompt: Which item is in the middle?

independent_check.teaching_block: Use the position clue without choices.
independent_check.passage: A lunch box is inside the open basket.

transfer_check.teaching_block: Transfer position words to a bedroom picture. Locate the object in relation to the bed.
transfer_check.passage: A pair of slippers rests beneath the bed.

levels.title: Describe one clear detail
levels.focus: write a complete sentence about a pictured action
levels.teaching_goal: Write one sentence that names a person or animal and accurately tells what is happening.

guided_check.teaching_block: A picture sentence needs who and what is happening. Worked example: “The dog chases a leaf.” is complete; “Chases a leaf” is missing who.
guided_check.passage: A boy is pushing a toy cart.
guided_check.prompt: Which sentence describes the picture completely?
options: The boy pushes a toy cart.
accepted_answers: The boy pushes a toy cart.
the boy pushes a toy cart

bridge.teaching_block: Choose only details present in the description. A complete sentence can still be wrong if it invents something.
bridge.passage: Two girls are sharing an umbrella.

masterclass.teaching_block: Include the place when it helps identify the action. Do not copy an option that changes the location.
masterclass.passage: A cat is sleeping on the wall.
masterclass.prompt: Which is the clearest picture sentence?
options: The cat sleeps on the wall.
The cat sleeps under a boat.
accepted_answers: The cat sleeps on the wall.
the cat sleeps on the wall

independent_check.teaching_block: Write in your own words. Include the person and the visible action; colour is optional.
independent_check.passage: A picture shows Rohan lifting a fallen book from the floor.
independent_check.prompt: Write one complete sentence about Rohan.

concept_slots.description: Says that he lifts or picks up the book.

transfer_check.teaching_block: Use the describing skill in a new setting: a bus-stop picture. Include who and the action shown.
transfer_check.passage: At a bus stop, an older child holds the door for a passenger.
transfer_check.prompt: Write one complete sentence describing the helpful action.

concept_slots.description: Says the child holds or keeps the door open.

levels.title: Tell what happens first
levels.focus: arrange pictured events into a sensible order
levels.teaching_goal: Order short event sentences by using what must happen first, next, and last.

guided_check.teaching_block: Use cause and result. Worked example: a seed is planted before it grows. Look for the action that makes the next action possible.
guided_check.passage: Cards: Mina throws the ball. Ravi catches the ball.

bridge.teaching_block: Preparation usually comes before play. A tied shoe allows the child to run safely.
bridge.passage: Cards: The race begins. Zoya ties her shoe.

masterclass.teaching_block: For three events, find the start and finish before placing the middle. The empty page must come before drawing.
masterclass.passage: Cards: The page is blank. Iqbal draws a house. He colours the roof.
options: blank page, draw house, colour roof
colour roof, blank page, draw house
draw house, colour roof, blank page
accepted_answers: blank page, draw house, colour roof

independent_check.teaching_block: Write the two events in a sensible order without choices.
independent_check.passage: Events: Neel opens the paint box. Neel paints a sun.
independent_check.prompt: Write what happens first, then next.
accepted_answers: Neel opens the paint box, then he paints a sun.
neel opens the paint box then he paints a sun
Neel opens the paint box. Then he paints a sun.

transfer_check.teaching_block: Transfer sequencing from play to packing a school bag. Use the same before-and-after thinking.
transfer_check.passage: Events: Tara closes her school bag. Tara puts the books inside.
transfer_check.prompt: Write the events in the sensible order.
accepted_answers: Tara puts the books inside, then she closes her school bag.
tara puts the books inside then she closes her school bag
Tara puts the books inside. Then she closes her school bag.

items.passage: In a park picture, Ali feeds two ducks while Sara watches.
A red cap hangs from the fence. A blue scarf lies on the bench.
Three children stand near a puppet stall. One adult sells tickets.
items.prompt: How many children are near the stall?

items.passage: A child carries a watering can. A gardener holds a spade.
The drummer taps a small drum.
A cheerful child waves from the stage.
items.prompt: Which word tells what the child does?

items.passage: The puppy follows the rolling hoop.
items.prompt: Which word shows the puppy’s action?

items.passage: Kavya folds a paper boat.
The kite is above the tree.
items.prompt: Which word tells where the kite is?

items.passage: A marble rests between two boxes.
The paintbrush lies next to the water cup.
items.prompt: Which position word could replace “next to”?

items.passage: A bird sits on top of the gate.
items.prompt: Write a position word that tells where the bird is.

items.passage: A picture shows a woman carrying vegetables.
items.prompt: Which sentence gives the full detail?

items.passage: A boy is mending a torn kite.
options: The boy mends the torn kite.
accepted_answers: The boy mends the torn kite.
the boy mends the torn kite

items.passage: Two children plant a small tree.
A picture shows a nurse giving water to a tired runner.
items.prompt: Write one complete sentence about the picture.

concept_slots.description: Says that the nurse gives water.

Cards: The tower falls. Dev stacks three blocks.
Events: Pavi picks up a crayon. Pavi colours the star.
